fields.label: Verified
fields.description: The record resolves publicly with this exact value. Set by the provider push, by Verify DNS Record and by the daily check.

fields.label: Last Checked At
fields.description: When the record was last pushed to the provider or verified.
Zone the record is published in. The host is relative to it. Defaults to the default zone for records created by hand.
fields.label: DNS Zone
Category
fields.description: What the record is for. Node: a server's own address. Ingress: the cluster hostname's round-robin entry. Egress: gateway and pool addresses. SPF: the include target customer domains reference. Other: created by hand.
Name relative to the zone, e.g. n1.blr for n1.blr.frappemail.com. Use @ for the zone itself.
fields.label: Host
Type
fields.description: Record type. A and AAAA carry IP addresses, MX a mail server name with a priority, TXT free text such as SPF, CNAME an alias.

fields.label: Priority
fields.description: MX only: lower numbers are tried first.

fields.label: TTL
fields.description: Seconds resolvers may cache the record. Blank uses the zone's TTL, then the default from Suite Cloud Settings.

fields.label: Value
fields.description: The record's content: an IP address, a hostname for MX and CNAME, or the text for TXT. Several records may share host and type with different values (round-robin).
Records owned by a cluster, node, gateway or pool are created and removed with it. Blank means created by hand.
fields.label: Managed By Type
fields.options:
Stalwart Cluster
Stalwart Node
Egress Gateway

fields.label: Managed By
fields.description: The document that owns this record.
